content.comment_body: Hello Forum, I'm trying to read power output from my solar inverter into [product_name]. I have the correct Modbus address, as it's working in Node-Red (HR30775). However, I'm not receiving data in [product_name]. I tried adjusting the address up and down, but still no luck. Also attempted sending data from Node-Red to Output—no success. Is there a way to visualize the data exchange for [product_name]? Thanks in advance.
Which [product_name] do you have? Please provide the complete [article_no].
Type: [product_name] [version_no] ([product_name][article_no]) Using [product_name] [version_no]. There isn't a working program yet because I'm not receiving data.
Where is your [product_name] program? Without a program, you won't be able to receive data.

I understand your question. I followed a video—the main difference is the Modbus address. The video connects [company_name] [product_name] to a PAC2200 and should work similarly for the SMA inverter. Tried three different Modbus addresses (+1/address/-1). [url]

You're overlapping addresses on the [product_name] side. Reading a double register means one register has 2 words, while a double register contains 4 words. Assign the first double register to VW0 = VW0 + VW2, the second to VW4 = VW4 + VW6, and the third to VW8 = VW8 + VW10.
Thanks for explaining about the VM. I haven't solved it yet, but your explanation helps a lot. I'll update if I need more assistance.
